# tool-box

> Loose toolbox of one-off Python and PowerShell scripts used to turn textbook PDFs into structured notes, summaries and figures.

## Python scripts
- extract_pdf.py, extract_toc.py, extract_toc2.py: pull body text and table of contents out of source PDFs
- extract_problems.py, extract_detailed.py, extract_full.py, save_chapters.py: split extracted text into chapter/problem files
- generate_summary.py, generate_summary_v2.py, generate_final.py, create_book_summary.py: build summary documents
- fix_quotes.py, fix_all_quotes.py, fix_multiline.py, scan_quotes.py, check_syntax.py, verify_doc.py: clean-up and sanity checks for generated Markdown/docx
- gen_images.py: render summary figures

## PowerShell ops
- reasonix-ops/reasonix-autocommit.ps1: scheduled auto-commit
- reasonix-ops/reasonix-doctor.ps1: environment health check
- reasonix-ops/backup-to-github.ps1: push backups to GitHub
- 工具箱推送.bat: Windows entry point for pushing the toolbox

## 备注
- summary_images/ holds 8 generated PNG figures (bayes, concentration, euler, induction, master, pagerank, rsa, well_ordering).
- Scripts are experimental, mostly one-off; no license file is present.
